title: ON.energy floating header
description: A fixed header that floats over the page: a yellow wordmark badge, five equal translucent glass pills with dropdown chevrons and a yellow mono CTA, 4px apart across the full width. Pills fill off-white on hover and open a glass dropdown. On phones it shrinks to one yellow pill in the top-right corner with a grid menu button that opens a full-screen yellow menu. The badge, pills and CTA retint to match the section underneath: black-and-yellow over yellow sections, dark over light ones.
notes: fixed to the top of the window: put it first on the page; the hero runs underneath it
the glass pills are made for dark or media backdrops
needs JavaScript for the phone menu (hydrate: load); dropdowns are CSS hover/focus

sections can set data-on-energy-tone="primary" (yellow) or "inverse" (light) on their root; the header follows the one under it while scrolling (the on-energy manifesto, testimonials, news and footer already do)
